comment: PrnD (aminopyrrolnitrin oxygenase) catalyzes the final N-oxygenation step in pyrrolnitrin biosynthesis, converting aminopyrrolnitrin into pyrrolnitrin by oxidation of an arylamine to an arylnitro group

reactions.description: Oxidation of the arylamine group of aminopyrrolnitrin to the corresponding arylnitro group in pyrrolnitrin.
